apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IMAGE.ARTIFACT.CHECKS.TESTS_RAN
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The pipeline gave a test report for the built image, and at least one test in it ran
  remediation: Give the build the test report of the tests that ran on the image it pushed.
spec:
  change_type: image_release
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: artifact
  assert:
    exists:
      in: tests
      where:
        all:
          - path: item.counts.tests
            greater_than:
              path: item.counts.skipped
          - any:
              - path: item.image_digest
                equal:
                  path: artifact.digest
              - path: item.image_digest
                in:
                  path: artifact.platform_digests

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IMAGE.ARTIFACT.SOURCE.BUILD_COMMIT_MATCHES_VERIFIED_COMMIT
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The commit the build tool's provenance names is the commit the server verified for the run
  remediation: Build the image with Buildx provenance, from the commit the run was opened for.
spec:
  change_type: image_release
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: artifact
  assert:
    path: artifact.build_commit
    equal:
      path: verified_source.commit
